annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it directs viewers from an advertised flash-loan arbitrage tool to connect MetaMask, pay stated BNB deployment, swapping and gas charges, and click Deposit and Execute before receiving a displayed 4.7437 BNB estimated profit on a 72 BNB loan. The upfront payment-and-deposit requirement is presented as the gateway to a rapid, large return, while the final wallet screen is used to imply success without documenting an actual flash-loan trade or the provenance of the payout.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S02 fits a funded-contract return solicitation: the source combines a specific BNB fee schedule, a profit figure, wallet connection and a deposit confirmation step. The problematic relationship is the instructed advance transfer for a purported arbitrage payout, not simply the existence of a DeFi tutorial.
